recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical, high-key conceptual portrait featuring a central figure emerging from a large, glowing pink lotus flower. The aesthetic is defined by extreme brightness, soft-focus blending, and a monochromatic white-to-pale-pink palette that creates a sense of divine or ethereal rebirth.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject emerging vertically from the floral base
Symmetrical arm placement creating a horizontal anchor
Transition from sharp facial detail to soft-glow body blending
Contrast between the cool platinum hair and warm skin tones
coreInvariants: High-key white background with no visible horizon
Soft-edged glow at the intersection of the figure and flower
Centered vertical alignment of the subject
Pale pink and white color dominance

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis; subject occupies the top two-thirds of the frame, emerging from the bottom third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The face of the subject, framed by long platinum hair, serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move down the torso to the glowing flower base, then outward along the extended arms.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive white negative space surrounding the upper body and head to emphasize purity and light.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white for background and lighting highlights.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale pink for the flower petals and subtle skin undertones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Darker tones in the eyes and lips for facial definition.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high value (brightness) with very low saturation across the entire image.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-condensed sans-serif and stylized display type.
letterConstructionRules: Sharp, pointed terminals on display characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical stems extended to 3x standard height
Bottom terminals of display letters tapering into points
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A standard ultra-condensed sans-serif for secondary info paired with a highly stylized, vertically-stretched version for the main title.
graphicDevices: Vertical alignment with the right edge of the flower

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary condensed skeleton for vertical stretching.
To achieve the specific pointed terminals at the base of the letters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-key studio portrait of a woman with long platinum blonde hair, centered, with arms outstretched. The lower half of her body should dissolve into a glowing, soft-focus pink lotus flower. The background must be pure white with a soft bloom effect.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned, ultra-condensed typography in the bottom right corner. The main title should be vertically elongated with sharp, pointed bottom terminals, colored in a muted rose-gold tone.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-key with minimal shadows?
Does the figure blend seamlessly into the flower?
Is the typography vertically stretched and right-aligned?
Is the color palette restricted to white, pink, and skin tones?

adjustableVariables: Degree of vertical stretch in the typography

mustAchieve: Seamless blending between subject and floral element
Clean, high-key lighting without blowing out facial features

postGenerationChecks: Check for symmetrical balance in the pose
Ensure the hair texture remains visible despite the high-key light
Verify the typography does not obscure the main subject
Confirm the 'glow' feels integrated rather than a filter overlay
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical High-Key Portrait + Floral Base Integration + Vertically Elongated Condensed Typography.
